scanNote:
2-UNITNING OXIRGI BETI (17-bet).

Yuqorida o'ngda 'Night and Day' va ko'k yorliqda oq '2'.

CHAP USTUN:
26) 'The picture shows life in ancient Egypt. Spot four mistakes in it, then use the prompts to make sentences, as in the example.'
Ostida CHIZMA RASM: qadimgi Misr manzarasi - orqada piramidalar va palmalar. Rasmda: tuya ustida qora KOSTYUM-ShIM kiygan erkak; oldida yashil ko'ylakdagi bola quloqchin (Walkman) taqib turibdi; o'rtada firavn kiyimidagi ayol qo'lida MOBIL TELEFON; o'ngda MOTOTSIKL ustidagi ikki qadimgi misrlik. Ayollarda BILAKUZUK, oyoqda SANDAL.
Ostida oltita ko'rsatma: 1 (they/wear sandals) - ko'k qiya namuna 'They used to wear sandals.'; 2 (they/ride motorbikes); 3 (they/listen to Walkmans); 4 (men/wear suits); 5 (women/wear bracelets); 6 (they/have mobile phones).
• Katta to'q sariq 'Pronunciation' sarlavhasi.
27) (kassetа belgisi bilan) 'Listen and underline the silent letters. Listen again and repeat.' Ikki qatorda sakkiz so'z: know - listen - write - often / talk - walk - hour - comb. 'know' so'zidagi 'k' harfi ostiga ALLAQAChON chizilgan (namuna).
• Katta to'q sariq 'Writing' sarlavhasi va qora yozuv '(an article about someone's lifestyle and how it has changed)'.
• To'q sariq ramkali quti - maqola yozish qoidasi (qalin harflar bilan ajratilgan iboralar).

O'NG USTUN:
28) (kassetа belgisi bilan) 'Listen and complete the notes in the table, then, in pairs, ask and answer questions about Bill Newton, as in the example.' Ko'k qiya namuna: 'SA: Did Bill use to live in a large house? SB: No, he didn't. He used to live in a flat.'
Ostida och ko'k jadval: ikki ustun THEN va NOW; to'rt qatorli sarlavha: HOME, APPEARANCE, EATING HABITS, FREE-TIME ACTIVITIES. Har katakda bosh harfi berilgan nuqtali bo'shliqlar.
29) 'You have been asked to write a magazine article about Bill Newton. Use the information from Ex. 28, and the plan below, to write your article (100 - 150 words). Use the text in Ex. 23 as a model.'
• Spiralli daftar shaklidagi ramkada REJA: Plan - Introduction (Para 1), Main Body (Para 2, 3), Conclusion (Para 4).
• Katta to'q sariq 'Words of Wisdom' sarlavhasi: 'Read these sentences. What do they mean?' Ramkada ikkita maqol: 'He lives long who lives well.' va 'As you make your bed, so you must lie upon it.'

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '17'.

exercises.instructionEn: The picture shows life in ancient Egypt. Spot four mistakes in it, then use the prompts to make sentences, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmda qadimgi Misrdagi hayot ko'rsatilgan. Undagi to'rtta xatoni toping, so'ng ko'rsatmalar bilan gap tuzing, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
RASMDAGI TO'RTTA XATO.

  Qadimgi Misrda BO'LMAGAN narsalar:

  1) MOTOTSIKL
  2) KOSTYUM-ShIM (suit)
  3) WALKMAN (quloqchinli pleyer)
  4) MOBIL TELEFON

  ⚠ Sandal va bilakuzuk esa qadimgi
  Misrda HAQIQATAN bo'lgan - shuning
  uchun 1 va 5-bandlar TASDIQ gap
  bo'ladi.


⚠ QOLIP:

  TASDIQ: They USED TO wear sandals.
  INKOR:  They DIDN'T USE TO ride
          motorbikes.

  ⚠ INKORDA 'USE' - 'used' EMAS!
  ⚠ "didn't used to" - eng keng
  tarqalgan xato.


⚠ QAYSI BAND TASDIQ, QAYSI INKOR:

  1  sandals        → TASDIQ (bo'lgan)
  2  motorbikes     → INKOR (xato)
  3  Walkmans       → INKOR (xato)
  4  men/suits      → INKOR (xato)
  5  women/bracelets → TASDIQ (bo'lgan)
  6  mobile phones  → INKOR (xato)

  ⚠ To'rtta INKOR - aynan rasmdagi
  to'rtta xato.


⚠ 'TO SPOT':

  = payqamoq, ko'zi tushmoq.
  ⚠ 'a spot' (ot) = dog'; joy.
  ⚠ 'spot the difference' - bolalar
  o'yini: farqni top.


⚠ 'ANCIENT':

  = qadimiy. /ˈeɪnʃənt/ deb o'qiladi.
  ⚠ 7-betdagi Tailand matnida ham
  bor edi: 'ancient temples'.


⚠ 'A WALKMAN':

  = ko'chma kassetali pleyer (Sony
  firmasining nomi).
  ⚠ Kitob 2000-yilda yozilgan - o'sha
  paytda bu eng zamonaviy qurilma edi.


⚠ 'A BRACELET':

  = bilakuzuk. Fransuzchadan kirgan.
  ⚠ Qadimgi Misrda erkaklar ham,
  ayollar ham taqqan.
modelAnswers: They didn't use to ride motorbikes.
They didn't use to listen to Walkmans.
Men didn't use to wear suits.
They didn't use to have mobile phones.

exercises.instructionEn: Listen and underline the silent letters. Listen again and repeat.
exercises.instructionUz: Tinglang va o'qilmaydigan harflarning tagiga chizing. Yana tinglang va takrorlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
O'QILMAYDIGAN HARFLAR (silent letters).

  ⚠ Ingliz tilida YoZILADIGAN, lekin
  AYTILMAYDIGAN harflar juda ko'p.
  Bu - imlo va talaffuz orasidagi
  eng katta farq.


BETDAGI SAKKIZ SO'Z:

  know   - 'K' o'qilmaydi  /nəʊ/
  listen - 'T' o'qilmaydi  /ˈlɪsn/
  write  - 'W' o'qilmaydi  /raɪt/
  often  - 'T' o'qilmaydi  /ˈɒfn/
  talk   - 'L' o'qilmaydi  /tɔːk/
  walk   - 'L' o'qilmaydi  /wɔːk/
  hour   - 'H' o'qilmaydi  /ˈaʊə/
  comb   - 'B' o'qilmaydi  /kəʊm/

  ⚠ Kitobda 'know' so'zidagi 'k'
  ALLAQAChON chizilgan - namuna.


UMUMIY QOIDALAR:

  'K' + N boshida → K jim:
     know, knee, knife, knock, knot

  'W' + R boshida → W jim:
     write, wrong, wrap, wrist

  'L' oldida A/O va keyin K/M/F →
  L jim:
     talk, walk, calm, half, could,
     should, would

  'B' oxirida M dan keyin → B jim:
     comb, thumb, lamb, climb, bomb

  'H' ba'zi so'zlarda jim:
     hour, honest, honour, heir
     ⚠ Bunday so'zlar oldidan 'AN'
     artikli keladi: 'AN hour',
     'AN honest man'.

  'T' -STEN/-FTEN da jim:
     listen, fasten, castle, often
     ⚠ 'often' da 't' ni aytish ham
     to'g'ri hisoblanadi - ikki xil
     talaffuz bor.


⚠ 11-BETDAGI 31-MAShQ BILAN BOG'LIQ:

  U yerda 'know' va 'no' bir xil
  o'qilishi ko'rsatilgan edi - aynan
  'k' jim bo'lgani uchun.

items.whyUz:
⚠ /nəʊ/ - 'k' O'QILMAYDI.
⚠ Kitobdagi NAMUNA.

⚠ Qoida: 'KN' boshida → K jim (know, knee,
knife, knock).

⚠ /ˈlɪsn/ - 't' O'QILMAYDI.

⚠ Qoida: '-STEN' da T jim (listen, fasten,
castle).

⚠ /raɪt/ - 'w' O'QILMAYDI.

⚠ Qoida: 'WR' boshida → W jim (write, wrong,
wrap, wrist).

⚠ Shuning uchun 'write' va 'right' bir xil
o'qiladi.

⚠ /ˈɒfn/ - 't' odatda O'QILMAYDI.

⚠ Lekin 't' ni aytish ham to'g'ri hisoblanadi -
ikki xil talaffuz mavjud.

⚠ /tɔːk/ - 'l' O'QILMAYDI.

⚠ Qoida: A/O + L + K/M/F → L jim (talk, walk,
calm, half).

⚠ /ˈaʊə/ - 'h' O'QILMAYDI.

⚠ Shuning uchun 'AN hour' ('a hour' XATO).
⚠ Yana: honest, honour, heir.

⚠ /kəʊm/ - 'b' O'QILMAYDI.

⚠ Qoida: '-MB' oxirida B jim (comb, thumb,
lamb, climb, bomb).

exercises.explanationUz:
BILL NYUTON - BRITANIYaNING ENG
MUVAFFAQIYaTLI KINO YULDUZI (29-mashq
rejasidan ma'lum).

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  SA: Did Bill use to live in a large
      house?
  SB: No, he didn't. He used to live in
      a flat.

  ⚠ Namunadan BITTA javob ma'lum bo'ladi:
  HOME / THEN = a FLAT.


JADVAL (bosh harflari kitobda berilgan):

  HOME
     THEN: a f___ in the middle of
           Bristol  → a FLAT
     * ⚠ NOW: a large h___ with a garden
       in the countryside (audiodan)

  APPEARANCE
     * ⚠ THEN: long hair, quite p___,
       blue j___ (audiodan)
     * ⚠ NOW: slim, handsome, s___ hair,
       expensive s___ (audiodan)

  EATING HABITS
     * ⚠ THEN: hamburgers, c___ (audiodan)
     * ⚠ NOW: f___, salads, orange juice
       (audiodan)

  FREE-TIME ACTIVITIES
     * ⚠ THEN: football, c___, rock
       concerts (audiodan)
     * ⚠ NOW: parties, nightclubs, t___
       (audiodan)


⚠ 'DID ... USE TO ...?' - SO'ROQ:

  'DID Bill USE to live ...?'
  ⚠ SO'ROQDA ham 'USE' - 'used' EMAS!
  ⚠ 'did' allaqachon o'tgan zamonni
  ko'rsatgan.


⚠ QISQA JAVOB:

  'No, he didn't.' - keyin to'liq gap:
  'He used to live in a flat.'


⚠ 'IN THE COUNTRYSIDE':

  = qishloq joyda, shahardan tashqarida.
  ⚠ 'the country' ham shu ma'noda
  ('mamlakat' bilan adashtirmang).


⚠ 'A FLAT' va 'AN APARTMENT':

  Britaniyada 'a flat', AQShda
  'an apartment'.
  ⚠ 16-betda 'a block of flats' bor edi.

⚠ Bristol - Angliyaning janubi-g'arbidagi shahar.

⚠ To'liq so'z AUDIODAN.
⚠ 'in the countryside' = qishloq joyda.

points.uz: TASHQI QIYOFA - O'ShA PAYT: uzun soch, ancha t..., ko'k j...
points.noteUz:
⚠ To'liq so'zlar AUDIODAN.
⚠ 16-betdagi maqolada ham 'plump' so'zi bor edi.

points.uz: TASHQI QIYOFA - HOZIR: nozik, kelishgan, k... soch, qimmat k...
points.noteUz:
⚠ To'liq so'zlar AUDIODAN.
⚠ 'handsome' - faqat ERKAK uchun (8-bet).

points.uz: OVQATLANISH ODATI - O'ShA PAYT: gamburger, k...
points.noteUz:
⚠ To'liq so'z AUDIODAN.
⚠ Britaniyada 'chips' = kartoshka fri.

points.uz: OVQATLANISH ODATI - HOZIR: b..., salatlar, apelsin sharbati.

points.uz: BO'SH VAQT - O'ShA PAYT: futbol, k..., rok konsertlari.

points.uz: BO'SH VAQT - HOZIR: bazmlar, tungi klublar, t...
points.noteUz:
⚠ To'liq so'z AUDIODAN.
⚠ 'a nightclub' - qo'shma ot, BIRGA yoziladi.

points.uz: SA: Bill katta uyda yashaganmi? SB: Yo'q. U kvartirada yashagan.

⚠ Kitobdagi NAMUNA.

⚠ SO'ROQDA va INKORDA 'USE' - 'used' EMAS!

sections.title: Writing (an article about someone's lifestyle and how it has changed)
sections.titleUz: Yozish (odamning turmush tarzi va uning o'zgarishi haqida maqola)

exercises.instructionEn: When we write an article about someone's lifestyle and how it has changed, we can divide it into four paragraphs.
exercises.instructionUz: Odamning turmush tarzi va uning qanday o'zgargani haqida maqola yozganda, uni to'rt xatboshiga bo'lish mumkin.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI QUTI - MAQOLA QOIDASI.


TO'RT XATBOShI:

  1-xatboshi:
     TO'LIQ ISM, qayerdan, kasbi
     ('what he/she does for a living')

  2-xatboshi:
     hayoti ILGARI qanday bo'lgan:
     uy, tashqi qiyofa, ovqatlanish
     odati, bo'sh vaqt

  3-xatboshi:
     BUGUNGI turmush tarzi

  4-xatboshi (oxirgi):
     o'zgarishlar haqida NIMA HIS
     QILADI


⚠ ZAMONLAR:

  'used to' yoki PAST SIMPLE →
     o'tmishdagi odatlar
  PRESENT TENSES →
     bugungi turmush tarzi

  ⚠ Bu 16-betdagi Liza haqidagi
  maqolaning AYNAN tuzilishi -
  shuning uchun 29-mashqda 'Use the
  text in Ex. 23 as a model' deyilgan.


⚠ 'TO DO SOMETHING FOR A LIVING':

  = tirikchilik uchun biror ish qilmoq.
  'What does he do for a living?'
  = uning kasbi nima?

  ⚠ 'What does he do?' bilan bir xil,
  lekin rasmiyroq.


⚠ 'NOWADAYS':

  = hozirgi kunda.
  ⚠ BITTA so'z, oxirida -S bor.
  ⚠ 'now a days' - XATO.


⚠ 'HOW IT HAS CHANGED':

  PRESENT PERFECT - o'tmishdagi ish,
  natijasi hozir ko'rinadi.
  ⚠ Bu 7-unitning mavzusi.

points.en: In the first paragraph, we write his/her full name, where he/she comes from and what he/she does for a living.
points.uz: Birinchi xatboshida uning to'liq ismini, qayerdanligini va kasbini yozamiz.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to do sth FOR A LIVING' = tirikchilik uchun
ishlamoq.

⚠ 16-betdagi C xatboshisi aynan shunday edi.

points.en: In the second paragraph, we write how his/her life used to be years ago. We write about his/her home, appearance, eating habits and free-time activities.
points.uz: Ikkinchi xatboshida uning hayoti yillar oldin qanday bo'lganini yozamiz: uyi, tashqi qiyofasi, ovqatlanish odati va bo'sh vaqt mashg'ulotlari.
points.noteUz:
⚠ To'rt mavzu - 28-mashqdagi jadvalning
to'rt qatori bilan AYNI.

⚠ 'used to be' - o'tmishdagi holat.

points.en: In the third paragraph, we write about his/her lifestyle nowadays.
points.uz: Uchinchi xatboshida uning hozirgi turmush tarzi haqida yozamiz.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'nowadays' = hozirgi kunda. BITTA so'z,
oxirida -S.

⚠ Zamon: PRESENT SIMPLE.

points.en: In the last paragraph, we write how he/she feels about these changes.
points.uz: Oxirgi xatboshida u bu o'zgarishlarni qanday his qilishini yozamiz.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to feel ABOUT sth' - predlog 'about'.

⚠ 16-betdagi B xatboshisi aynan shunday edi:
Lizaning fikri va iqtibos.

points.en: We use used to or the past simple to talk about the person's past habits, and present tenses to talk about his/her lifestyle nowadays.
points.uz: Odamning o'tmishdagi odatlari haqida 'used to' yoki past simple, hozirgi turmush tarzi haqida hozirgi zamonlarni ishlatamiz.
points.noteUz:
⚠ Zamonlarni ARALAShTIRMANG: o'tmish qismi
butunlay past, hozirgi qismi butunlay present.

exercises.instructionEn: You have been asked to write a magazine article about Bill Newton. Use the information from Ex. 28, and the plan below, to write your article (100 - 150 words). Use the text in Ex. 23 as a model.
exercises.instructionUz: Sizdan Bill Nyuton haqida jurnal maqolasini yozish so'ralgan. 28-mashqdagi ma'lumot va quyidagi rejadan foydalanib maqola yozing (100 - 150 so'z). 23-mashqdagi matnni namuna qiling.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI REJA:

  INTRODUCTION
     Para 1: 'Bill Newton is Britain's
        most successful film star.
        However, things were not always
        easy for the boy from Bristol.'

  MAIN BODY
     Para 2: past lifestyle
     Para 3: present lifestyle

  CONCLUSION
     Para 4: "Bill's life has changed a
        lot since those days in Bristol.
        'I enjoy my success and hope it
        will continue for many years to
        come,' he says."

  ⚠ Kirish va xulosa GAPLARI kitobda
  BERILGAN - siz faqat 2 va 3-xatboshini
  yozasiz.


⚠ REJADAGI GAPLARNI TAHLIL QILING:

  "Britain's most successful film star"
  ⚠ 'Britain's' - EGALIK apostrofi.
  ⚠ 'the most successful' - eng yuqori
  daraja, lekin egalikdan keyin 'the'
  TUShADI.

  'However, things were not always easy'
  ⚠ 'However' - qarama-qarshilik
  bog'lovchisi, 16-betdagi maqolada
  ham xuddi shu joyda edi.

  'has changed a lot SINCE those days'
  ⚠ PRESENT PERFECT + since.

  'for many years to come'
  ⚠ = kelajakdagi ko'p yillar davomida.


⚠ HAJM: 100-150 SO'Z

  To'rt xatboshi uchun - har biri
  2-4 gap.


⚠ 'A MAGAZINE ARTICLE':

  = jurnal maqolasi.
  ⚠ 'a magazine' - jurnal;
  'a journal' - ilmiy jurnal, kundalik.

structure.modelEn: Bill Newton is Britain's most successful film star. However, things were not always easy for the boy from Bristol.
structure.modelUz: Bill Nyuton - Britaniyaning eng muvaffaqiyatli kino yulduzi. Ammo Bristollik bu bola uchun hammasi ham oson bo'lmagan.
structure.noteUz:
⚠ Kitobda BERILGAN.
⚠ "Britain's" - egalik apostrofi.
⚠ 'However' - qarama-qarshilik bog'lovchisi.

structure.modelEn: Bill used to live in a flat in the middle of Bristol. He had long hair and he was quite plump. He used to wear blue jeans. He liked eating hamburgers and chips. In his free time he used to play football, go to the cinema and go to rock concerts.
structure.modelUz: Bill Bristol markazidagi kvartirada yashardi. Uning sochi uzun edi va ancha to'ladan kelgandi. Ko'k jinsi kiyardi. Gamburger va kartoshka fri yeyishni yaxshi ko'rardi. Bo'sh vaqtida futbol o'ynar, kinoga va rok konsertlariga borardi.
structure.noteUz:
⚠ 28-mashqdagi jadvalning ChAP ustuni.
⚠ 'used to' + past simple aralash ishlatiladi -
ikkalasi ham to'g'ri.

⚠ Aniq so'zlar AUDIODAN tasdiqlanadi.

structure.modelEn: Today, Bill lives in a large house with a garden in the countryside. He is slim and handsome, with short hair, and he wears expensive suits. He eats fish, salads and drinks orange juice. He enjoys going to parties, nightclubs and the theatre.
structure.modelUz: Bugun Bill qishloq joyda bog'li katta uyda yashaydi. U nozik va kelishgan, sochi kalta, qimmat kostyum kiyadi. Baliq, salat yeydi va apelsin sharbati ichadi. Bazmlarga, tungi klublarga va teatrga borishni yoqtiradi.
structure.noteUz:
⚠ 28-mashqdagi jadvalning O'NG ustuni.
⚠ Zamon: PRESENT SIMPLE.
⚠ 'enjoy' dan keyin HAR DOIM -ING.

structure.modelEn: Bill's life has changed a lot since those days in Bristol. "I enjoy my success and hope it will continue for many years to come," he says.
structure.modelUz: Billning hayoti Bristoldagi o'sha kunlardan beri ancha o'zgardi. "Muvaffaqiyatimdan zavqlanaman va u yana ko'p yillar davom etishiga umid qilaman", - deydi u.
structure.noteUz:
⚠ Kitobda BERILGAN.
⚠ 'has changed ... since' - PRESENT PERFECT.
⚠ 'for many years to come' = kelajakdagi ko'p
yillar davomida.

exercises.instructionEn: Read these sentences. What do they mean? - He lives long who lives well. As you make your bed, so you must lie upon it.
exercises.instructionUz: Bu gaplarni o'qing. Ular nimani anglatadi? - Yaxshi yashagan uzoq yashaydi. To'shagingni qanday solsang, shunga yotasan.
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI MAQOL.


1) 'HE LIVES LONG WHO LIVES WELL.'

  So'zma-so'z: 'Yaxshi yashagan odam
  uzoq yashaydi.'

  MA'NOSI: Umrning uzunligi YILLAR
  soni bilan emas, MAZMUNI bilan
  o'lchanadi. Yaxshi, foydali yashagan
  odamning umri to'la hisoblanadi.

  ⚠ SO'Z TARTIBI ESKI:
  'He lives long WHO lives well.'
  = 'The person who lives well lives
     long.'
  ⚠ Zamonaviy inglizchada bunday
  yozilmaydi - bu maqol qadimiy.

  ⚠ O'zbekchada: 'Umr uzunligi bilan
  emas, mazmuni bilan qadrli.'


2) 'AS YOU MAKE YOUR BED, SO YOU MUST
   LIE UPON IT.'

  So'zma-so'z: 'To'shagingni qanday
  solsang, shunga yotishing kerak.'

  MA'NOSI: Har kim o'z qilmishining
  oqibatini o'zi ko'radi.

  ⚠ 'to make the bed' = to'shakni
  yig'moq/solmoq - 14-betdagi
  13-mashqda ham bor edi!

  ⚠ 'to lie' = yotmoq
     lie - lay - lain (NOTO'G'RI fe'l)
  ⚠ 'to lie' = yolg'on gapirmoq
     lie - lied - lied (TO'G'RI fe'l)
  ⚠ IKKI XIL 'lie' bor - adashtirmang!

  ⚠ 'upon' = 'on' ning ko'tarinki
  shakli (maqol va she'rlarda).

  ⚠ 'AS ... SO ...' - qadimiy qolip:
  'qanday ... shunday ...'

  ⚠ O'zbekchada: 'Ekkaningni o'rasan.'


⚠ NIMA UChUN BU MAQOLLAR ShU YERDA:

  Unit KUNDALIK TARTIB va TURMUSh
  TARZI haqida. Ikkala maqol ham
  odamning O'Z hayotini qanday
  quriishi haqida - unit mavzusiga
  to'g'ri keladi.

items.en: He lives long who lives well.
items.answerEn: It means that the length of a life is not as important as how well you live it.
items.answerUz: Bu shuni anglatadiki, umrning uzunligi emas, uni qanday o'tkazganing muhim.

items.en: As you make your bed, so you must lie upon it.
items.answerEn: It means that you must accept the results of your own actions.
items.answerUz: Bu shuni anglatadiki, har kim o'z qilmishining oqibatini o'zi ko'radi.

items.en: Is there a similar saying in your language?
items.uz: Sizning tilingizda shunga o'xshash maqol bormi?
items.answerEn: Yes. In Uzbek we say: 'You reap what you sow.'

patterns.exampleEn: They didn't use to ride motorbikes.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ INKORDA 'USE' - 'used' EMAS!
⚠ "didn't used to" - eng keng tarqalgan xato.

patterns.formula: Did he use to [fe'l]? - No, he didn't.
patterns.exampleEn: Did Bill use to live in a large house? - No, he didn't.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ SO'ROQDA ham 'USE' - 'used' EMAS!
⚠ 'did' allaqachon o'tgan zamonni ko'rsatgan.

patterns.formula: [Kim]'s life has changed a lot since [vaqt].
patterns.exampleEn: Bill's life has changed a lot since those days in Bristol.
patterns.exampleUz: Billning hayoti Bristoldagi o'sha kunlardan beri ancha o'zgardi.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ PRESENT PERFECT + 'since' - o'zgarish natijasi
hozir ko'rinadi.
⚠ Maqolani yakunlashning tayyor qolipi.
